_notes.goal: Built for limited/hyped shoes that restock at random through the day — poll often and get pinged instantly.
_notes.sizes: Empty list means alert on ANY restock; otherwise only these sizes.
_notes.retailer: Auto-detected from the URL. Supported: footlocker, kidsfootlocker, champssports, footaction. Add 'retailer' explicitly if you only pass a sku.
_notes.active_hours: Set both to null (remove them) to monitor 24/7.
_notes.dashboard: Run with --dashboard to get a live web UI at http://localhost:8000.
_notes.price_drops: Optional extra: set track_price_drops=true and a per-product target_price to also alert on price falls.
_notes.proxy_and_cookies: If you hit HTTP 403/429, add a 'proxies' and/or 'cookies' object; see README.
